targets.sql: SELECT execution_date, duration_minutes FROM etl_metadata WHERE execution_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY execution_date
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(created_at)))/3600 as hours_old FROM fact_attendance

SELECT DATE(created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as count, 'Attendance' as metric FROM fact_attendance GROUP BY DATE(created_at) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as count, 'Enrollment' as metric FROM fact_enrollment GROUP BY DATE(created_at)

SELECT 'NULL Foreign Keys' as check_name, COUNT(*) as error_count FROM fact_attendance WHERE student_sk IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'Invalid GPA' as check_name, COUNT(*) as error_count FROM fact_score WHERE gpa < 0 OR gpa > 4.0 UNION ALL SELECT 'Negative Duration' as check_name, COUNT(*) as error_count FROM fact_attendance WHERE duration_minutes < 0
